approach.eyebrow: How I think about the work
approach.paragraphOne: I enjoy taking a workflow with a lot of moving parts and giving it a dependable shape: clear boundaries, useful APIs, thoughtful interfaces, and room to grow.
approach.paragraphTwo: My work often sits close to the backend, while keeping the whole product experience in view.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.description: A little more about my work, the technologies I use, and how we can get started.

expertise.question: What does backend-focused full-stack development mean?
expertise.answer: I work closely with server-side systems, APIs, data, and authentication, while also building the React and Next.js interfaces people use to access them.

technology.question: Which technologies do you work with?
technology.answer: My work includes TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, REST APIs, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Mongoose. The right tools depend on the product and its needs.

projects.question: What kinds of projects have you built?
projects.answer: My portfolio includes full-stack education and streaming platforms, a mosque management system, this portfolio, and Tarikul Open MCP, a remote server that connects Google Calendar to compatible clients.

services.question: What can you help build?
services.answer: I work on full-stack web applications, backend services and REST APIs, and responsive frontend interfaces. The services page describes these areas and shows related projects.

collaboration.question: How do you approach a collaboration?
collaboration.answer: I start by understanding the users, workflow, and constraints, then agree on a useful first scope. I build connected pieces, review the result, and refine it based on feedback.

contact.question: How can I discuss a project with you?
contact.answer: Use the contact page to reach me through the listed contact options or schedule a conversation. Sharing the problem, intended users, and any constraints is a helpful place to start.
